_doc: Parcel demand inputs for scripts/forecast_growth.py, from the ACM Post- en Pakketmonitor. Volumes are millions of parcels delivered in the Netherlands as reported per edition; ACM revises earlier years between editions (2024 was 606 in the 2024 monitor, 609 in the 2025 monitor), so the series is indicative, not one consistent definition. ooh_share = share of parcels collected out of home (servicepunt + pakketkluis/other location). Scenario growth rates are this project's assumptions, anchored on the 2023-2025 growth (+1.9%, about +2%, +0.9%) and the locker shift (ACM: 2,800 -> 4,800 -> 9,309 kluizen). b2c_share = business-to-consumer share of the domestic volume (ACM Post- en Pakkettenmonitor 2020: 74,0%; 2021: 504 of 654 million = 77%); later editions do not publish the split, so the latest value is used. ooh_split = the afhaal-aandeel by place (ACM 2025: 12.4% servicepunt, 5.3% kluis/other location); a scenario's ooh_share_pp_per_year rise goes to the kluis share.
source: ACM Post- en Pakketmonitor 2020-2025 (acm.nl), via ACM-publicaties en samenvattingen van Thuiswinkel.org

laag.note: Volume blijft vlak (PostNL Q1 2026: -7,1% pakketten), aandeel afhalen blijft 17,7%

midden.note: Volume groeit als 2023-2025 (gemiddeld ~1,6%), aandeel afhalen +0,5 procentpunt per jaar

hoog.note: Volume groeit door internationale webwinkels (ACM 2025: +7,4% grensoverschrijdend), aandeel afhalen +1 procentpunt per jaar door kluizen
